title: Chameleon wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail spiral -->
  <path d="M22 62 Q10 60 10 50 Q10 40 20 40 Q30 40 30 50 Q30 58 23 58 Q17 58 17 52 Q17 47 22 47" fill="none" stroke="#3fbf5f" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="60" rx="26" ry="15" fill="#4fd96f"/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="67" rx="20" ry="7" fill="#a4f5b8"/>
  <!-- back spots -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="52" r="3" fill="#2f9a48"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="50" r="3.5" fill="#2f9a48"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="54" r="3" fill="#2f9a48"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="58" r="2.5" fill="#2f9a48"/>
  <!-- front legs -->
  <path d="M60 70 L64 82 L70 82" fill="none" stroke="#3fbf5f" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <path d="M42 71 L38 83 L32 83" fill="none" stroke="#3fbf5f" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="42" rx="15" ry="13" fill="#5de87c"/>
  <!-- head casque bump -->
  <path d="M68 30 Q74 22 82 30" fill="#5de87c"/>
  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <rect x="60" y="36" width="11" height="9" rx="3" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <rect x="73" y="36" width="11" height="9" rx="3" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <rect x="70.5" y="39" width="3" height="2.5" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <path d="M59 38 L55 37" stroke="#1a1a2e" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M84 38 L88 37" stroke="#1a1a2e" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <circle cx="63" cy="39" r="1.5" fill="#8fd3ff"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="39" r="1.5" fill="#8fd3ff"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M70 51 Q76 56 82 51" fill="none" stroke="#2f9a48" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- curled tongue -->
  <path d="M84 52 Q92 52 92 47 Q92 42 88 43" fill="none" stroke="#ff5fa2" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
